sql: SELECT event_id, ts, upn, result, ip, asn_org, country, city, device_id, app, mfa_prompt_count, risk_flag, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' ORDER BY ts DESC

SELECT ts, asn_org, country, ip, result, device_id, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND asn_org NOT IN (SELECT asn_org FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND result IN ('success','mfa_approved') AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60' DAY AND asn_org IS NOT NULL GROUP BY asn_org HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(ts AS DATE)) >= 2) ORDER BY ts
SELECT session_id, upn, ts_start, ts_end, appliance_id, client_ip, assigned_ip FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vpn_session WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' ORDER BY ts_start

SELECT i.department, s.country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event s JOIN lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.identity i ON i.upn = s.upn WHERE i.department = 'Faculty' GROUP BY i.department, s.country ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' GROUP BY country ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT session_id, upn, appliance_id, ts_start, ts_end FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vpn_session WHERE ts_end IS NOT NULL AND ts_end < ts_start
SELECT event_id, ts, kind, verdict, sender_domain, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' ORDER BY ts

SELECT s.ip, COUNT(DISTINCT s.upn) AS accounts, COUNT(*) AS failures, MIN(s.ts) AS first_ts, MAX(s.ts) AS last_ts FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event s WHERE s.result = 'failure' AND s.ip IN (SELECT ip FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND result = 'success') GROUP BY s.ip ORDER BY accounts DESC
SELECT event_id, ts, verdict, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND kind = 'rule' ORDER BY ts

SELECT event_id, ts, result, ip, asn_org, mfa_prompt_count FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND result IN ('mfa_denied','mfa_approved') ORDER BY ts
SELECT event_id, ts, country, device_id, user_agent, app, mfa_prompt_count, via_vpn_appliance FROM auth_pg.signin_events WHERE event_id IN ('evt_000078','evt_000079')
SELECT event_id, ts, ip, device_id, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND asn_org = 'Turkcell' ORDER BY ts

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT upn) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE ip = '193.140.10.21' AND result IN ('success','mfa_approved') AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY
SELECT result, COUNT(DISTINCT upn) AS accounts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE ip = '193.140.10.21' GROUP BY result
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE ip = '193.140.10.21' AND upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND result = 'success'

SELECT d.device_id, d.firmware, v.cve_id, v.vendor, v.product, v.date_added, v.ransomware_use FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.device d LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vulnerability v ON LOWER(v.product) LIKE '%connect secure%' WHERE d.device_id = 'vpn-edge-01'

SELECT d.device_id, d.firmware, v.cve_id, v.vendor, v.product, v.date_added, v.ransomware_use FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.device d LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vulnerability v ON LOWER(v.product) LIKE '%connect secure%' WHERE d.device_id = 'vpn-edge-02'
SELECT device_id, type, os_version, firmware FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.device WHERE device_id = 'vpn-edge-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND via_vpn_appliance = 'vpn-edge-01'
SELECT device_id, type, os_version, firmware FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.device WHERE device_id = 'vpn-edge-02'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu' AND via_vpn_appliance = 'vpn-edge-02'
SELECT cve_id, product, date_added, ransomware_use FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vulnerability WHERE LOWER(product) LIKE '%connect secure%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.upn IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_record FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.identity i ON i.upn = s.upn WHERE s.upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_record FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'prof.kaya@aegean.edu'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ts_end IS NOT NULL AND ts_end < ts_start THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_record FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.vpn_session WHERE appliance_id = 'vpn-edge-01'
